description: This Java class 'ShortcutHelper' manages Android app shortcuts, including creating, updating, pinning, enabling/disabling, and fetching favicons for URLs. It interacts with Android's ShortcutManager and handles shortcut refresh logic.

classes.name: ShortcutHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing Android app shortcuts, including creation, refresh, pinning, enabling/disabling, and favicon fetching.

methods.name: maybeRestoreAllDynamicShortcuts
methods.description: Checks and potentially restores dynamic shortcuts.

methods.name: reportShortcutUsed
methods.description: Reports usage of a shortcut by ID.

methods.name: callShortcutManager
methods.description: Executes a ShortcutManager operation with error handling and rate-limiting feedback.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves all shortcuts (manifest, dynamic, pinned) without duplicates.

methods.name: refreshShortcuts
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes shortcuts if they are stale or forced.

methods.name: createShortcutForUrl
methods.description: Creates a ShortcutInfo object for a given URL.

methods.name: setSiteInformation
methods.description: Sets label and icon for a shortcut based on URL.

methods.name: setExtras
methods.description: Adds refresh timestamp to shortcut extras.

methods.name: addWebSiteShortcut
methods.description: Adds a shortcut for a URL, optionally requesting pinning.

methods.name: requestPinShortcut
methods.description: Requests to pin a shortcut by ID.
